versions.subject: Schtasks creation rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: 'schtasks.exe'
selection_flag:
    CommandLine|contains: ' /create '
selection_folder:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '%AppData%'
        - '\AppData\Local\'
        - '\AppData\Roaming\'
        - '%Public%'
        - '\Users\Public'
        - 'C:\Windows\Temp'
        - 'C:\Perflogs'
condition: selection and selection_flag and selection_folder
